trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (DBA) and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable. The diagnosis confirms a robust combination is favored given unstable rankings and high error correlation, which is exactly what DBA provides. With only 3 validation windows, further weight estimation is high-variance noise. Accepting is the right call.

action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (0.92) with moderate seasonality (0.32) and non-stationary. Model ranking is highly unstable (Kendall tau 0.018) and errors are heavily correlated (mean 0.886, only 2 independent groups), so no subset or fitted weighting can reliably outperform a robust full-pool combination. DBA (DTW barycenter) captures the shared trend structure across all 19 models while being robust to the few models that deviate, and its lead over the runner-up (median) is not statistically distinguishable with only 3 validation windows. Accepting the robust baseline is the safest and most defensible choice.
